_note: G7 BLAST8 (G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-47, owner 2026-10-29: 'thrown and ragdoll arc with realistic depth + can enter short comas depending how big the blast was, their armor and how close to proximity of blast'). Read by sim/systems/blast8.gd (hooked at the end of Shrapnel.burst: artillery / mortar splash, grenades, drone and strike munitions). All numbers PROVISIONAL (untuned). Model: charge W (kg TNT-equivalent) per blast profile; scaled distance Z = d_m / W^(1/3) (Hopkinson-Cranz); a body with Z < z_throw is thrown D = throw_k x W^(1/3) x (1 - Z / z_throw)^throw_pow x clamp(mass_ref / mass, 0, mass_fac_max) x armour.throw metres away from the burst (clamped to walkable ground: never into a building, a wall or off a wall-walk), peak height = min(height_k x D, height_max_m), flight time = 2 sqrt(2 H / g) (>= min_flight_s); landing hurts by land_dmg_per_m per metre of peak above land_safe_m. Soldiers with Z < z_conc are knocked unconscious when sev = (1 - Z / z_conc)^conc_pow x armour.conc >= conc_min, for conc_min_s .. conc_max_s seconds (linear in sev, +-conc_var from w.rng), woken early (treated_wake_s) once a medic stabilises them.

g7_blast8._note_daze: ACCURACY8B (13.9c-53, owner 'Yes, dazed', PROVISIONAL): a soldier within Z < z_daze who is NOT knocked out is dazed: sev = (1 - Z / z_daze)^daze_pow x armour.conc (none below daze_min), for daze_min_s .. daze_max_s seconds (linear in sev, no draw). e.b8d = until tick; Accuracy8 reads it (aim x0.55, shot placement to limbs, weapon cooldown x1.4 and +0.6 s to switch targets).
